name: Chat log: delivered whispers are logged with their exact text, refused and addon whispers are not
contract: With CoA.ChatLog.Enable on, a whisper that reaches its receiver writes one coa_chat_log row for the sender: type whisper, the receiver as target, and the text exactly as delivered, also with quotes, a backslash, percent and brace characters, an emoji, CJK text and an item link.
A whisper to a name nobody has writes no row, and an addon message (LANG_ADDON, hidden from players) writes no row.
The receiver's answer is a row of its own with the first sender as target.
Two-word names are written in full, up to 25 characters: a whisper from or to one names the whole name, and the text is the message without the quoted second word.
